title: OpenWoud: Vendor-Unlocked Scalable Adaptive Random Forest Accelerator
abstract: arXiv:2611.32662v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Online Machine Learning (ML) enables real-time decision-making on evolving data streams. These dynamic models learn continuously to adapt to new concepts, as previous ones become invalid, but their performance is often limited by throughput. The Adaptive Random Forest (ARF) is a state-of-the-art model for this setting, which naturally exposes parallelism and is therefore well-suited for hardware acceleration. However, prior Field Programmable Gate Array (FPGA)-based accelerators are vendor-locked and rely on resource-hungry Floating-Point (FP) arithmetics, limiting their scalability and portability. We present OpenWoud, a vendor-unlocked ARF framework for FPGAs. Our design replaces FP operators with a flexible FiXed-Point (FxP) arithmetic library and introduces fully transparent, manually scheduled dataflows for training and drift detection. translated_title: OpenWoud：无厂商锁定、可扩展的自适应随机森林加速器
translated_abstract: 在线机器学习（ML）能够在不断演进的数据流上实现实时决策。这些动态模型持续学习以适应新概念，因为旧概念会逐渐失效，但其性能往往受到吞吐量的限制。自适应随机森林（Adaptive Random Forest, ARF）是这一场景下最先进的模型，它天然具备并行性，因此非常适合硬件加速。然而，现有的基于现场可编程门阵列（FPGA）的加速器存在厂商锁定问题，并且依赖资源消耗巨大的浮点（FP）运算，这限制了其可扩展性和可移植性。我们提出了OpenWoud，一个无厂商锁定的FPGA ARF框架。我们的设计用灵活的定点（Fixed-Point, FxP）运算库替代浮点算子，并为训练和漂移检测引入了完全透明的、手动调度的数据流。这使得能够进行细粒度的时间/面积权衡，并保证跨平台的可预测行为。（注：原摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: OpenWoud是一个无厂商锁定的FPGA自适应随机森林加速框架，通过定点运算库替代浮点运算并引入完全透明的手动调度数据流，实现了细粒度的时间/面积权衡与跨平台可移植性。
en_tdlr: OpenWoud is a vendor-unlocked FPGA framework for Adaptive Random Forest acceleration that replaces floating-point operators with a flexible fixed-point arithmetic library and introduces fully transparent, manually scheduled dataflows, enabling fine-grained time/area trade-offs and predictable cross-platform behavior.
